mapping.expression: ($event := $context.headers.`x-github-event`; $delivery := $context.headers.`x-github-delivery`; $action := action; $exists($event) and $event != "" and $exists($delivery) and $delivery != "" ? { "event_type": "github." & $event & ($exists($action) and $action != "" ? "." & $action : ""), "source_event_id": $delivery, "payload": $ } : $error("GitHub webhook requires non-empty X-GitHub-Event and X-GitHub-Delivery headers."))

presentation.name: GitHub
presentation.description: Verified GitHub repository or organization webhooks. Configure the webhook manually in GitHub with this Connection's callback URL and shared secret; Integrios never provisions or manages the GitHub side.
